subject: Amplify Health: consolidate partner-led console workshop & dry-run
messages:
From: Erin Mooney <erin@amplify.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to compress workshop + partner lead

Hi Jordan,

We have two internal constraints at Amplify that make the originally booked two-day console + API enablement tricky: several execs can only join one afternoon, and our SREs are only available in a narrow evening window. Can we compress the two-day workshop into a single partner-led 4-hour block where your team runs the console walkthrough and our partner (ClearRoute) covers integrations?

If possible, we also want a dry-run in Redwood sandbox 24 hours ahead to validate tokens and the data masking demo. Proposed consolidated slots: Sep 9 13:00-17:00 ET or Sep 10 18:00-22:00 ET.

Attached is our attendee matrix and prereqs.

Thanks,
Erin
Amplify Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Mooney <erin@amplify.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to compress workshop + partner lead

Hi Erin,

Thanks for the context — doable but we need to coordinate a few things internally before confirming. Quick notes:
- A compressed 4-hour partner-led session is fine if we split time roughly: 90m console walkthrough (Redwood), 60m partner integration demo (ClearRoute), 30m hands-on lab, 30m Q&A/next steps.
- We must run a sandbox dry-run 24h before (we can do Sep 8 AM PT / Sep 9 AM ET for the Sep 9 slot).
- Need SSO test accounts and one sample payload for the data-masking demo; I see you attached the matrix — thanks.

Camila — can you take the console walkthrough lead and own the dry-run (env checks + sample prompts)? Ben — can you confirm availability for the evening window if we need Sep 10 18:00-22:00 ET?

Erin — if you confirm preferred slot and the list of attendees with roles, we’ll lock the runbook and share Zoom/drive links + a short preflight checklist.

-Jordan
Product Solutions 
Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Erin Mooney <erin@amplify.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to compress workshop + partner lead

On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 10:05 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Camila — can you take the console walkthrough lead and own the dry-run (env checks + sample prompts)?

I can take that. Quick checklist I’ll run through on the dry-run:
- Confirm API keys and SSO access to sandbox (I’ll request temporary creds if SSO is blocked)
- Validate model variant and quantization profile for the live demo (to hit latency targets)
- Preload KV prefixes for the hands-on lab to avoid cold-start lag
- Run the data-masking prompt set Erin sent and confirm outputs

I’m available Sep 8 09:30-12:30 PT for the dry-run and can do Sep 9 13:00-17:00 ET for the consolidated workshop. Ben — I’ll need backup for the last 30m Q&A in case of parallel tracks.

Camila
Enablement Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Mooney <erin@amplify.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to compress workshop + partner lead

Jordan / Camila —
I’m available for the Sep 9 afternoon slot and can cover the last 45m Q&A and the hands-on lab facilitation. If Amplify expects heavy load on embeddings/reranking, I’ll swap to a lower-latency model variant for the demo — let me know expected token rates.

If we end up needing the evening Sep 10 slot, I can take Sep 10 18:00-22:00 ET as well but would prefer Sep 9 to avoid weekend handoffs.

-ben
Customer Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Erin Mooney <erin@amplify.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.p@amplify.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to compress workshop + partner lead

Thanks everyone — Sep 9 13:00-17:00 ET works best for execs and SREs. Attendee roles attached (we’ll have two execs for the intro, 3 SREs for the hands-on, and product managers for Q&A).

Samir — Can you confirm ClearRoute will take the integrations slot and coordinate with Camila on the runbook? We’ll need the sandbox dry-run on Sep 8 09:30 PT as Camila suggested.

Erin

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Mooney <erin@amplify.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to compress workshop + partner lead — confirmed schedule & runbook

All — confirmed. Final plan below and I’ve uploaded the runbook to the shared Drive link.

Final schedule (Sep 9, 2026 ET):
- 12:00 PT / 15:00 ET: Redwood dry-run (Camila lead) — Zoom link and preflight checklist in Drive
- 13:00-14:30 ET: Console walkthrough (Camila)
- 14:30-15:30 ET: ClearRoute integrations demo (partner)
- 15:30-16:00 ET: Hands-on lab (Ben to facilitate)
- 16:00-16:30 ET: Q&A & next steps (Jordan closes)

Action items:
- Erin: share final attendee emails and SSO contact by EOD Aug 31
- Samir / ClearRoute: confirm speaker list and upload slide deck to the Drive folder
- Camila: validate sandbox access and run the dry-run Sep 8 09:30 PT
- Ben: prepare two short troubleshooting snippets for common access errors

Attachments: amplify_prereqs.pdf, session_agenda_v2.docx, env_access_steps.txt
Links: Zoom (https://zoom.us/j/9876543210), Drive (https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/amp-enablement-8421), HubSpot HS-12345

I’ll follow up with calendar invites and the DocuSign link for the partner NDAs if needed. Thanks everyone — looking forward to a tight, focused session.

-Jordan
Product Solutions, Redwood Inference
